english.title: Park a motor vehicle / bicycle / conveyance on the Croydon Tramlink system without paying the appropriate charge
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the person in charge of a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[bicycle]_
(C)_[conveyance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONVEYANCE..)]_

parked it in a place, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE..), on the Croydon Tramlink system where charges were made for parking without paying the appropriate charge at the appropriate time in accordance with instructions given by the Operator or other person on their behalf at that place
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 15(2) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
